_comment: Tears in the sky (Jonah, 2026-10-12): thin jagged rifts high above the land, ten for one step, then twenty-five,
then fifty, each shimmering and now and then sealing for a minute or two. Every tear in an Age alike, in one of
three styles drawn from its seed: glowing, dark, or the End's starfield. The mod's own geometry on Ephemeris's
Never bought where the book set `sky.torn`.
